sec.title: Fake Government App Exposes Italy’s Expanding Spyware Surveillance Industry
sec.brief: S. S. CISA adds N-able MailAssure and Project MONAI flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog An Android app called FirmaDigitale promised asylum seekers news on their protection status, instead, it was delivering spyware. An IrpiMedia investigation by Rosita Rijtano builds on Lookout’s 2024 discovery and attributes the malware to IPS, a Latina supplier to prosecutors, police and intelligence agencies. Nobody knows who ordered the operation or whom it hit. ]it, a page mimicking the website of Italy’s primary postal service provider Poste Italiane. The app displayed the Interior Ministry logo and mentioned a protection decree. Police deny any link to it, and Poste didn’t comment. The spyware could add components to use the microphone, intercept internet calls, record the screen and track the phone. It could also reach contacts, call logs, files and texts. The site has been unreachable since 2025, but the app could still circulate elsewhere.
